observed_content: Test determinant-isotypic spaces of C[(F_p^2)^m] for Q=x²+y² under O2(F_p). Zero-extension J_m(f)=f⊗δ0 injects the character space and intertwines old-level operators but not the Fourier on the new slot. Exact leakage squared =1-1/p². Exact dimensions: p3 2->3:6->78, p5 1->2:1->66, p3 1->2:0->6, p5 2->3:66->1891.
